analysis.description: Opening subject and answer entries only, manually transcribed from the score and checked against Saayman's discussion. The rest of the fugue is not represented.

notes: The excerpt covers mm. 1–22. The source uses cut time; the horizontal coordinate remains in quarter-note units. The core includes the tie into the next entry's first bar, so adjacent statements overlap by one quarter note. The third entry starts in m. 12 after a one-bar link. Manual reading of the public-domain score, corroborated by Saayman's discussion of entry order and subject design. Quarter-note coordinates are relative to each fugue, not to its prelude. Only the opening exposition is mapped. Entry endpoints mark the subject core; continuing counterpoint and extensions are not automatically included.
